mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user_identity i INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.identity_type = #{identityType} AND i.identity_value = #{identityValue} AND i.verified_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
